verdict.rationale: cubic's built-in AI can take delegated tasks inside the product. Users tag @cubic-dev-ai in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews and fix issues; they can request one-click fixes or auto-fix, and cubic pushes the fix to the PR branch. An in-product AI chat also answers questions about a PR. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated tasks working, delegation scope documented only for review, fix and Q&A rather than general tasks, and the AI chat sidebar documented only in archived pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues. You can tag `@cubic-dev-ai` directly, or reply to cubic's existing comments to continue the conversation.
Request a targeted fix with one click, or turn on auto-fix to have cubic fix the issues from every review of a pull request.
cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
AI chat answers questions about a pull request while you read it. It reads the PR and the rest of your codebase.
